content.text:
**Chicken:** You have about 1.96 days left. That is 47.9 lb on hand against 24.43 lb/day of theoretical use over 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-04. (stock_runway rev1; inventory_counts.csv COUNT-CLOSE-CHICKEN rev1, counted 2026-10-04 23:00.)

**Next Alder delivery:** Planning uses Monday and Wednesday, with orders due by noon the day before. That comes from note N09 (ledger belief 448b4f6e13d8). The vendor sheet says Monday and Thursday (vendors.csv V1 rev1, last reviewed 2026-09-14). Under the sources.precedence policy, the newer note overrides the sheet, so the sheet is flagged as stale. I don't have today's date, so I can't name the exact next date.

**Chicken already on order:** INV-099 (invoice_headers.csv rev1) lists 2 cases of AW-CHK20, 20 lb each, for 40 stock lb. It has a delivery date of 2026-10-06, and the office status is "received". Note N15 says the cases were not seen. Under the inbound.on_hand_rule policy (physical_confirmation), I don't count those 40 lb as on hand until someone confirms they arrived. Without them, the 1.96 days stands.

Someone needs to confirm whether INV-099 arrived. The restaurant only captures this if someone records it, so a quick check at the door would settle it.
